lines.note: The session list on the left, the pane on the right: → steps in, ← or Esc back out. Everywhere: Enter opens, Space toggles, E opens your editor; in lists a adds, x removes (on the session list: a Notes tab, x stop).

lines.text: New session: agent, name, Tab for the workspace (↑↓ a new worktree's base), Enter launches
Select a session (or type its number)
Open it full screen: the agent, or what the tab shows (shell, Git, Dev); on Notes, Enter edits them here, o in vim
Back to Deckhand from full screen (Ctrl+Space works too)
Next / previous tab: Preview, Terminal, Git, Dev, Notes (Shift+Tab goes back too)
Tasks: the repository's task list (n starts a session from one) / Worktrees: what is merged, delete them
Settings / Agents: versions and updates (Enter updates, r re-checks)
This guide (↑↓ or 1-9 pick a topic, / searches, Esc closes)
Quit the UI (agents and the daemon keep running); everywhere else Esc goes back
Sub-session of the selected one: clean, ⑂ a fork of it, or ↳ from its handoff (after H)
Stop, asking first (and whether to delete its worktree) / force-stop at once; starting: cancel
Resume an exited session (or retry a failed setup) / restart it with a fresh conversation
Mark done / not done (☑; any session, not the same as merged)
Merge the worktree into this branch (see Git & PRs) / mark it merged without merging (✓)
Archive an exited session (on an archived one: remove it for good, asking first) / archive or unarchive any
Export a Markdown handoff (notes, commits, changed files, diff stat) and open it

lines.note: A fork copies the conversation as saved then, not a turn in progress.
Deleting a worktree on stop is blocked by uncommitted work or unpushed commits unless you type DELETE.
A row: number, tree, status, title, then markers and the agent. Archived rows are dimmed (except in the archived view, which lists only them).

lines.text: Starting or working · idle · running, activity unknown · exited
Needs input · unread reply (attaching reads it) · rate-limited
Before the title: failed (red) or interrupted (yellow)
Has sub-sessions: expanded / collapsed (c)
Clean / forked sub-session
Dev runs in this worktree (on its first row)
Archived · merged · done (Space; its title muted)
After the title: cleanup error · N hidden sub-sessions
Agent: Claude · Pi · Codex
Runs an older agent version than installed: restart it (x, then s) to update
Shares the selected session's worktree: Terminal, Git, Dev
Header: N sessions need attention (! jumps to them)

lines.note: Below the list: the selected session's full title, agent · state · age (both versions when ↑), branch or main checkout, then ╎N (N others share the worktree) ▶ ✓ ☑2d (done 2 days ago) ▣, ☐ N open checklist items.

lines.text: Select by number (0 is 10; with more than 10, type the number: Enter or a short pause selects, Esc clears)
Search titles, notes, tasks, agent, branch and path (Enter keeps it, Esc clears)
Filter menu: a active · r running · ! attention · e exited · A archived · * all; f f back to active (the sidebar header names any other)
Next session that needs attention: blocked ones first, then unread replies
Move the session down / up among its siblings
Hide exited children → collapse → expand
Narrow / widen the sidebar
Reload the list (it updates live; rarely needed)
Jump to Preview, Terminal, Git, Dev, Notes (d twice quickly also starts or stops Dev)
Step into the pane: scroll the preview (running), browse Git changes, edit the notes
Step back out to the session list
On Terminal: switch between the shell and the last action
Open in Cursor / VS Code: the note on Notes, otherwise the session's folder
Scroll (PgUp/PgDn a page, g/G top/bottom, the mouse wheel; + − change wheel speed)

lines.note: Agents ask for approvals in their own terminal: open it (Enter) to answer. Terminal, Git and Dev belong to the worktree: all its sessions share them, also after their agents exit.
A worktree has one note, shared by its sessions; a main-checkout session has its own and the main checkout's. Autosaved Markdown; removed notes go to notes/trash.

lines.text: Edit here (Esc ends) / in vim: Ctrl+X, Ctrl+T, Ctrl+] back
Main checkout: switch between this session's note and the shared one
Check / uncheck the line's item, or make the line a - [ ] item
New checklist item below (Enter on an item continues the list)
Jump a word (Ctrl+←→, Alt+B/F too); Alt+Backspace or Ctrl+W deletes one, Alt+Delete the next
Start / end of the line (Home / End too; Ctrl+Home/End: the note; PgUp/PgDn a screen)
Send the line's checklist item to Tasks (the note keeps a ↗ link)
Open the note in Cursor / VS Code (Ctrl+O while editing)

lines.note: ☐ N open below the sidebar counts open items of both notes. A worktree's note goes when its last session is removed (removing asks first; Enter sends open items to Tasks).
One list per repository. A worktree (or main-checkout session) has one task, ◆; its to-dos are its note's checklist, shown under it as steps (2/5).

lines.text: The board: a group per worktree with its task, backlog, done / only the selected session's worktree
Add here (on a worktree: a step to its note) / a backlog task
Edit it (Tab: details, Ctrl+S saves); on a step, open its note
Start a session for it (↑↓ picks the base) / move it: backlog, its note, a worktree or session (its task, or a step in its note if it has one)
Tick or reopen (a step: in its note) / delete (x twice)
Open the session doing it / reorder (j k, g G move)
Every note by worktree (a sends an item, A all its open ones, Enter opens it, f only open items) / the list in your editor

lines.note: Merging, or marking all its sessions done, ticks ◆ (undoing reopens it); work removed unmerged sends it back. m, x and W send the note's open items to the backlog too (Space keeps them).

W lists every worktree of the repository (Deckhand's or not) by what to do with it: merged and safe to delete, merged with leftovers, in progress, idle (nothing running for 14 days), missing (directory gone), and the main checkout.

lines.text: Delete it, asking first: keep or delete its branch; its running sessions are stopped first (named before you confirm)
On the "Merged · safe to delete" heading: delete all of them and their branches, one confirmation
Select its session in the sidebar
Mark it merged or clear the marker / open it in your editor
Check them all again / move

lines.note: Same safety as x on a session: uncommitted work or commits only on the branch need DELETE typed; the main checkout and the one this Deckhand runs in are never deleted. Its sessions are archived afterwards (f A shows them).

lines.text: Workspace overview: branch, changes, diff size, base, upstream
Merge / squash into this branch, uncommitted (Space: commit first; conflicts: Enter keeps, x aborts)
On the Git tab (the worktree's changes, VS Code style): browse them / open lazygit

lines.heading: Browsing changes (→; ← or Esc back; o opens lazygit)

lines.text: Select a file (g/G or Home/End: first/last)
Stage it, or unstage it if staged (a staged conflict is resolved)
Stage everything except conflicts / unstage everything
Open it in Cursor / VS Code at its first change
Scroll its diff (Page Up/Down: a page)

lines.heading: Inside i (Esc closes; ↑↓, j k and PgUp/PgDn move through it)

lines.text: Create a PR: push the branch, then open GitHub's PR form (asks first)
Fetch PR and check status (gh)
Open the PR in the browser
Open the Git tab
Run: Dev first (start or stop it), then your actions; Enter runs the selected one
In the run list: stop the running action (or Dev)
The Dev tab (Enter opens it while it runs) / twice quickly: start or stop Dev

lines.note: Dev is shared by every session in the same worktree and keeps running after their agents exit, until stopped (or the worktree is deleted).

An action runs in its own process beside the shell and Dev, one at a time per worktree, and shows on the Terminal tab (v: back to the shell); Enter opens it while it runs; its output and exit code stay until the next one.
Set the Dev command, actions and a setup command for new worktrees in Settings (C).
Two columns: Global (every repo) and This repo (deckhand.json in the main checkout; fine to commit). This repo wins.

lines.text: In effect / a repo value that applies once trusted ((built-in): Deckhand's default)
Setting / column (Tab too; PgUp/PgDn, Home/End jump)
Edit / clear the cell (Actions: a adds, x removes; Linked items: Space, a adds a path, Enter saves)
The column's raw JSON (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+F formats) / review and trust the repo file

lines.note: A repo's commands only run once you trust it; you're asked right before. Your edits here keep it trusted.

lines.heading: Agent signals (Settings → Agents; on for Claude unless switched off)

lines.note: Sessions report working, needs input, done, failed or rate-limited (! jumps to them) and what they wait on (a question, a plan, a command, their last line), and can notify you. Claude needs nothing; Codex: switch on, then `deckhand hooks codex` in ~/.codex/hooks.json; Pi has none. "Done" means it stopped, not that it succeeded.
